name: Deore XT 11-speed 11–46T cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 437 g for the exact CS-M8000 11-speed 11–46T cassette; other available ranges do not inherit this mass. Lockring inclusion follows the contribution convention. The 11–46T option is listed for a single chainring only.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2017 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 29: XT CS-M8000 eleven-speed cassettes: 411 g 11–40T, 447 g 11–42T and 437 g 11–46T
